description: Semantic and relational stability engine responsible for maintaining coherence across substrate evaluations.

semantic_continuity.description: Continuity of meaning across parse units; primary semantic stability metric.

relational_integrity.description: Stability of relational connections between parse units; prevents orphaning and circular references.

entropy_index.description: Measure of relational and semantic disorder; used to modulate CE.

anchor_density.description: Density of temporal, semantic, and relational anchors in the substrate.

intent_vector.description: Intent direction used to evaluate semantic alignment.

coherence_state.description: Snapshot of coherence metrics used for CPC and regime feedback.

coherence_threshold.description: Minimum Coherence Score (CE) required for stable operation.

evaluator_mode.description: Evaluator authority level for coherence verification and correction.

coherence_signal.description: Primary output consumed by Drift, Clarity, and Regime engines.
